objective: Route a generic safety-eligible candidate in NEEDS_BUILD through the existing bounded ChatGPT continuation transport so ChatGPT can author exactly-scoped projectexecutor work, while preserving fixed protocol validators, explicit same-chat routing, NO_PROVEN_EDGE, no-autopush and all live/cost/wallet guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: A generic NEEDS_BUILD overlay with no prospective protocol creates exactly one idempotent external continuation bound to an explicit proven control route.
Protocol-backed NEEDS_BUILD candidates continue using the existing fixed local deathcheck validator and do not enter the generic ChatGPT build route.

The external continuation preserves deterministic NEXT/DONE/BLOCKED task identities, bounded delivery retries and conflict detection, and includes bounded project context without treating candidate prose as authority.
Missing/invalid route configuration, unsafe live/paid/wallet flags, ambiguous candidate provenance or continuation identity conflict fail closed.
Supervisor installation provenance pins build_wake.py in addition to the existing supervisor/candidate/evidence policy files.
Targeted continuation, build-wake, candidate-dispatch and supervisor regressions pass from the canonical remote source.
The updated continuation_manager.py is installed to the allowlisted prediction-chat-bridge runtime, prediction-chat-wake.service restarts active, and an installed-runtime import assertion passes.
A local autobuild control-route file points to a route task demonstrably delivered to this chat and its referenced route binding exists.
A synthetic safe generic NEEDS_BUILD canary creates a continuation wake record without live trading, paid actions, wallet actions, remote Git push or owner-source mutation.
non_goals: Live trading, order placement/cancellation, wallet or fund movement.
Automatic economic promotion or changing NO_PROVEN_EDGE.
Replacing the fixed prospective-protocol deathcheck validator.
Allowing WSL to push to GitHub.
General unrestricted shell or code execution by the Codex supervisor.
independent_verification: Deterministic pytest/unittest regressions plus an installed-runtime canary executed through the capability-scoped projectexecutor; technical PASS does not qualify an economic edge.
rollback_plan: Revert the GitHub commits for this build, reinstall the previous continuation_manager.py from the pre-build canonical commit into the allowlisted chat-bridge runtime, remove the autobuild_control_route.json runtime file, restart prediction-chat-wake.service, and leave candidate/runtime evidence intact.
cleanup_plan: Keep immutable task/build evidence. Remove only synthetic canary runtime records after verification if they are not needed for the audit trail; never delete real candidate evidence.
